study_role: small engineering stress pilot before any larger superiority confirmation
question: Can the unchanged v7 tensor validity contract reduce silently invalid coherence measurements relative to conventional acquisition QC when previously unseen BioSR inputs undergo prospectively fixed, coordinate-preserving degradations?
measurement_rule: Use the source configuration appropriate to each acquisition family. Estimators, physical scales, reference rules, invalidity tolerances, support components, score boundary and comparators are unchanged.

selection.selection_rule: Exclude every v7 confirmation cell, then rank remaining central-directory cell identifiers by the unchanged v7 SHA-256 selector. Pixel values and endpoint outcomes are forbidden inputs.

randomness.rule: For stochastic conditions, derive a NumPy seed from SHA-256(base_seed|base_pair_id|condition_id), using the first eight digest bytes modulo 2^32.

registration.rule: Audit registration once on each undegraded source pair and reuse that eligibility record for every coordinate-preserving degradation of that pair.
registration.rationale: Every frozen transformation preserves array extent and specimen coordinates; rerunning registration would make reference eligibility a degradation detector and confound the validity-policy comparison.

interpretation_rules.pass: Advance unchanged contract to a larger untouched confirmation; this pilot alone is not publication-level confirmation.
interpretation_rules.fail: Diagnose the named degradation and support component, repair only on development evidence, then rerun on different untouched cells under a new lock.
interpretation_rules.not_assessable: Do not add clean samples. Expand only the predeclared severity envelope under an explicit development amendment until comparator-invalid emissions exist.

access_boundary: Before this candidate and its lock are completed, no pixel array or endpoint outcome from the six selected v8 cells may be decoded or computed. Central-directory names and MRC headers are permitted.
claim_boundary: Engineering stress pilot of an unchanged tensor validity contract. Not independent publication confirmation, biological ground truth, image-restoration accuracy, diagnosis, clinical validity, or proof of a universal NOSTOS contract.
